You will work closely with end users, follow documented procedures and contribute to the accuracy of our asset and inventory data. The ideal candidate is organised, service-oriented and takes pride in delivering consistent, high-quality support. Support device swap, repair coordination and reimaging activities, ensuring continuity of service for end users with minimal disruption. Schedule and conduct user handovers professionally, providing basic orientation on new equipment and escalating non-standard or complex issues when required. Update and maintain asset records and inventory data in the ticketing toolset, ensuring accuracy at every stage of the device lifecycle. Prepare devices for reuse or disposal, including supporting data wiping procedures and coordinating device packaging and shipment in line with agreed processes. Act as on-site remote hands at assigned locations, supporting infrastructure and network teams where specialised expertise is not available locally. This includes power cycling equipment, running basic diagnostics, confirming network connectivity, performing visual inspections and assisting with basic rack and stack operations where required. Availability to support activities outside standard business hours, including weekends, may be required with prior notice — particularly in the context of infrastructure maintenance windows, switch upgrades, disaster recovery or business continuity exercises. Experience using a ticketing tool such as ServiceNow, Remedy, Jira Service Management or equivalent. Ability to follow documented procedures accurately and update records consistently. Strong communication skills with professional, user-facing manner and a customer-first approach. Organised and reliable, with the ability to manage concurrent tasks and prioritise workload effectively. Compliance with safety protocols and quality standards is always expected, as this role acts as the on-site representative of the company's technology and service standards. Nice To Have ITIL Foundation, CompTIA A+, Microsoft Fundamentals or equivalent vendor hardware certification. Experience supporting Mac OS environments. English is required.
